shots.content: Inside a seminar room, a rectangular worktable stands between a pinboard and the entrance, with windows along one side. A man in a purple shirt sits in the pinboard-side window seat and asks for an account of the missing report to review every detail. A woman in a green shirt sits in the pinboard-side aisle seat. A woman in an orange shirt sits in the entrance-side aisle seat.
shots.viewpoint: Wide establishing shot from the entrance end, looking lengthwise along the worktable toward the pinboard, with both window-side seats and both aisle-side seats in frame.

shots.content: A man in a red shirt enters and sits in the entrance-side window seat. A man in a purple shirt asks him to explain the details.
shots.viewpoint: Medium two-shot from the aisle side, centered on the two adjacent window-side seats.

shots.content: A woman in an orange shirt asks a man in a purple shirt if the evidence matches the account.
shots.viewpoint: Reverse wide shot from the pinboard end, looking lengthwise along the worktable toward the entrance, with both window-side seats and both aisle-side seats in frame.
